offering_description.value: Sells cloud software and data products to life sciences companies, including drug, biotech and medical device makers, to run commercial, clinical, regulatory and quality operations. Delivered as hosted subscriptions, with implementation and training services.

primary_products.value: life sciences CRM software; clinical and regulatory content management software; quality and compliance software; commercial data products

primary_services.value: implementation and consulting; customer training; validation support

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device companies

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; medical devices; consumer health

revenue_model.value: subscription: hosted cloud software subscriptions for life sciences applications; service fees: implementation, consulting and training services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud applications sold to life sciences companies; service provider: implementation and consulting for customers' software deployments

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Japan and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: CRM, content management, quality and commercial data applications, all sold to life sciences companies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to pharma and biotech companies; partners / resellers: consulting and systems integration partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: GxP validation, 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records rules, and data privacy laws such as GDPR and HIPAA
